description: Election Commission - Declare that A. M. M. Nazik was selected as the member of the Kinniya Urban Council and G. Kulamani as member of the Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha and Kinniya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of elected members to fill positions vacated by resignation, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and declarations.
